title: Interpreting safety outcomes across public sources in pivotal antibody-drug conjugate trials: data and code
description: Archived aggregate extraction data, source-audit annotations, portable Python descriptive reanalysis and execution outputs for a 23-trial case study of safety reporting across publications, ClinicalTrials.gov and regulatory reviews. The package includes 28 retained source-row records. Computation checks reproduce results from extracted inputs and existing annotations; they are not independent source extraction or human adjudication. Copyrighted primary-source full texts and reviewer correspondence are excluded.
